name: ivhub-tests
description: Regression suite for the IV Hub pages. The site itself is static HTML and needs none of this to run.

scripts.test: node tests/verify.cjs && node tests/wd-team.cjs && node -e "var f='tests/sweep4-team.cjs';if(require('fs').existsSync(f))process.exit(require('child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,[f],{stdio:'inherit'}).status||0)" && node -e "var f='tests/sweep4-hub.cjs';if(require('fs').existsSync(f))process.exit(require('child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,[f],{stdio:'inherit'}).status||0)" && node -e "var f='tests/roster-design.cjs';if(require('fs').existsSync(f))process.exit(require('child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,[f],{stdio:'inherit'}).status||0)"
